title: Ticket Price
problem: Read an age. Print the ticket price in dollars as a number: 0 if the age is under 5, 5 if it is 5 to 12, 10 if it is 13 to 64, and 7 if it is 65 or older. For example, 30 gives 10.
starter_code:
# Read an age.
# Print the ticket price as a number.

# Write your code here

hints.1: There are four age groups. Think about the age where each group starts and the age where it ends.
hints.2: Use an if/elif/else chain. Test the youngest group first with a less-than, then use less-than or equal for the ages in between, and let else take the oldest group.

failure_explanation: Look closely at the ages where the price changes: an age exactly on the edge of a group belongs to that group. Under 5 means 5 itself is not free. Print just the number, with no dollar sign.
